description: This Java source file defines the AccountTransferDetails entity class, which models the details of an account transfer within the system. It includes fields for source and destination accounts, offices, clients, transfer types, and associated transactions and standing instructions. The class provides static factory methods for creating different types of transfers (savings-to-savings, savings-to-loan, loan-to-savings, loan-to-loan) and methods to access related accounts and transfer information.
